Hi Product Hunt,I'm Arick, co-founder and CEO of BAND. Today we're launching BAND for Developers.If you run more than one coding agent, you know the pattern. Each agent is fast on its own, but they can't talk to each other, so you become the go-between. You copy context from one session into the next, tell the test agent what the refactor agent just changed, and find out an hour later that two agents made opposite assumptions about the same interface. More agents should mean more work done. Instead, a lot of it turns into more coordination for you.Most multi-agent dev tools today give you a better dispatch board. You assign tasks, agents run in parallel, you review what comes back. That helps with throughput, but every handoff still goes through a human.BAND for Developers lets the agents work it out between themselves:- Connect the agents you already run. Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot and OpenCode agents join shared rooms across machines. You keep your IDE, your terminal and your workflow.- Agents collaborate directly. They message each other, delegate, review each other's work and unblock one another. They can pull in a teammate's agent when the work needs it. Plans, decisions and work state live in the room rather than inside one session, so they survive when a session ends.- You step in when it matters. You keep working from the terminal. BAND desktop shows what's moving, what's blocked and which agent is waiting on you. Open the room, answer the question or redirect the agent, then step back out while the rest of the work keeps going.The difference is that the agents aren't only running side by side. They coordinate while the work is happening, so many of the handoffs you'd normally do yourself happen without you. And you don't have to move your whole team onto one vendor's agents to get there.BAND desktop is free. Download it at band.ai/use-cases/band-desktop. We'd like to hear where it breaks for you, especially if your agents run across more than one harness. The team and I will be in the comments all day.

comments.text: Hi Product Hunt, I'm Asaph, Head of Product at Flagsmith. Product and Engineering teams have been using Flagsmith flags for years to release safely. Plenty of them already split traffic with our multivariate flags, and then try to track and join exposure and conversion events using other tools to see whether the change worked. Many teams stop before getting any results, or find the process so complicated that they never try again. So we built the other half into Flagsmith - Today we’re launching Flagsmith Experiments as a public beta, in the open-source core and on Flagsmith Cloud. How it works: - Start from an A/B flag you already run, in your code, using our SDKs - Connect your warehouse - we currently support ClickHouse and Databricks, and BigQuery and Snowflake will be available soon. On our Flagsmith Cloud you can use a fully managed warehouse with a 2-click setup. - Create an Experiment with a hypothesis, and pick the audience using Flagsmith Segments or from external cohorts we sync with (we support Amplitude and Mixpanel) - Create a metric from your events, or use an existing one from your warehouse. - Get results based on a Bayesian engine, with Chance to beat and Lift indicators. - End the experiment and you're back on the flag - roll out the winner or roll back Where the data lives is your call. Bring-your-own-warehouse is part of the open-source edition. We kept v1 small on purpose: a Bayesian engine, one primary metric per experiment, and SDKs for JavaScript, React, Python, Java, Node.js, Go and Flutter. The fastest way to get started is to use our prebuilt prompt with your favorite coding agent, visit our docs for more info. One thing that surprised us while dogfooding this ourselves is that our experiments gave us better questions more often than final answers. That’s why we designed it to show the result, and a possible recommendation, but the call is still yours. What would you need to run your next experiment here? Gagan, Wadii, both Matts and I are here to discuss and answer your questions (while we’re actually together at our engineering offsite in Portugal!). And to help you get started we’re offering the first 20 teams a free 30-min setup session with me - to claim your session let me know in the comments what you’d test first!

With gzip-compressed builds (static sites, Unity WebGL, fonts) one wrong header breaks the page. - No way to download a whole folder from the console. - Clearing CloudFront cache is a slow, multi-step process, and stale cache is easy to miss. What Hoistbay does: - Per-bucket header rules by file pattern (*.js, *.wasm.gz, *.html...) applied automatically on every upload - Upload and download whole folders, structure kept - One-click CloudFront invalidations with live status - Multiple AWS profiles and regions, switch instantly - One Activity panel for every upload, download and cache clear Your keys stay in the macOS Keychain or Windows Credential Manager. comments.text: A harness includes everything surrounding the model—such as the system prompt, tools, memory, skills, and subagents. Traditionally, this setup is designed once and remains unchanged for every task the agent performs.Harness² introduces adaptability, enabling the agent to independently tailor its setup for each task while keeping model weights static.With this approach, the agent proposes changes to its harness, tests multiple configurations, and refines it based on performance insights from those trials.Because it learns from run-to-run variations, there's no need for a defined correct answer or an external grader to assess results.This process isn't limited to single tasks. Harness² also transfers learnings across tasks.Once a task is complete, the agent retains the optimized harness and the recurring insights from those runs. When working on a new task, it builds on this accumulated knowledge rather than starting over.This continuous refinement enhances future task performance.In trials with Gemini 3.5 Flash and GLM-5 on legal, office, and professional benchmarks, Google found that even one round of edits surpassed the performance of fixed harnesses, with further iterations driving additional improvement.This points to self-healing, self-growing harnesses... 🤯

comments.text: We're launching the general availability of Jockey today, and it's shaped by what we learned during the research preview. Creators and marketers kept asking us: "Why is this video trending? What specific hooks are holding attention? What common patterns make these reels go viral?" We listened, and built social intelligence features that analyze video hooks, breakdown visual and audio pacing, and explain what actually works across trending content. We also added social ingestion of URL links from YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram Reels, so users can analyze what's working in the wild and search performance alongside content without having to upload videos. It's a whole new way to deconstruct viral video performance.Library-level understanding is the point. You point Jockey at thousands of videos and images, and it reasons across all of them, not just one. شدن این ریلزها می‌شوند؟» ما گوش دادیم و ویژگی‌های هوش اجتماعی ساختیم که هوک‌های ویدیویی را تحلیل می‌کنند، ریتم بصری و صوتی را شکسته‌سازی می‌کنند و توضیح می‌دهند که چه چیزی واقعاً در محتوای ترند جواب عملکرد را در کنار محتوا جستجو کنند. این یک روش کاملاً جدید برای شکسته‌سازی عملکرد ویدیوهای وایرال است. درک سطح کتابخانه نقطه کلیدی است. شما جاکای را به سمت هزاران ویدیو و عکس هدایت می‌کنید و آن روی week.aiReview: مسئله اصلی این است که کاربران و سازمان‌ها با حجم عظیمی از داده‌های ویدیویی دست‌وپنجه نرم می‌کنند که جستجو در آن‌ها با روش‌های سنتی بسیار کند و ناکارآمد است. راه‌حل ارائه‌شده، استفاده از هوش مصنوعی مولد و مدل‌های چندوجهی (Multimodal) برای درک عمیق محتوای ویدیو و عکس است تا جستجو بر اساس مفهوم و زمینه انجام شود. از نظر معماری، این محصول از یک لایه پردازش ویدیو برای استخراج ویژگی‌ها، یک پایگاه داده برداری (Vector DB) برای ذخیره‌سازی و جستجوی سریع، و یک لایه API/SDK برای یکپارچه‌سازی با چت‌بات‌های محبوب مانند ChatGPT استفاده می‌کند. مدل درآمدی ترکیبی از اشتراک‌های B۲B و فروش دسترسی به API برای توسعه‌دهندگان است. نقاط قوت شامل درک سطح کتابخانه (Library-level understanding)، قابلیت اتصال به چت‌بات‌های معروف و تحلیل هوشمند الگوهای وایرال شدن محتواست. نقاط ضعف می‌تواند شامل هزینه بالای محاسباتی برای پردازش ویدیوهای طولانی و وابستگی به زیرساخت‌های ابری خارجی باشد. نکته طلایی برای ایران: تمرکز بر بازار داخلی و ارائه قابلیت‌های تحلیل محتوا برای پلتفرم‌های بومی مانند آپارات و اینستاگرام (با دور زدن محدودیت‌های دسترسی مستقیم) می‌تواند مزیت رقابتی قوی ایجاد کند، به ویژه برای آژانس‌های تبلیغاتی که نیاز به تحلیل سریع عملکرد کمپین‌های ویدیویی دارند.

iranEquivalent.description: یک پلتفرم هوش مصنوعی که کل آرشیو ویدیویی و تصویری کاربران را تحلیل و سازماندهی می‌کند. این ابزار امکان جستجوی عمیق بر اساس محتوا، افراد و لحظات خاص را در میان هزاران ساعت فیلم‌برداری فراهم می‌کند. همچنین قابلیت تحلیل الگوهای ترند و وایرال شدن محتوا در شبکه‌های اجتماعی را دارد.

week.name: Talanoa
week.description: Talanoa is your first email messenger. It turns messy email threads into clean, chat-like conversations, removing quotes, signatures and clutter along the way. Turn emails into actionable todos, manage your calendar without leaving your inbox, and use private, on-device AI to search, summarize and write. Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud or any IMAP account in one unified inbox. Everything stays on your computer: no cloud sync, no tracking, no one reading your emails.

comments.text: Hey Product Hunt 👋 I’m John, the solo maker behind Talanoa. Funny enough, Talanoa was never supposed to become a product. I originally built it just for myself. I spend a huge part of my day in email, but I never really liked using traditional email clients. So instead of looking for yet another one, I started building the inbox I wanted for myself. Then I showed it to a few friends. They loved it. They started using it. And eventually, they put enough pressure on me to turn my little personal project into a real product. So… here we are. Along the way, one idea became increasingly obvious to me: Email is a conversation that forgot it was one. A thread between two people is basically a chat. A message, a reply, a reply to the reply. Yet email clients still show repeated quotes, signatures, headers, footers and years of clutter. So I rebuilt Talanoa around a different idea: what if email felt more like a messenger? Today, Talanoa turns your inbox into clean, chat-like conversations, while keeping everything that makes email, email. But it goes further: 💬 Emails become actual conversations ✅ Any email can become a todo with a next step and due date 📅 Your calendar lives alongside your conversations ✨ AI helps you search, summarize and write, entirely on-device 📥 Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and IMAP accounts can live in one inbox 🔒 No cloud sync, no tracking. Your emails stay on your computer. I’ve been building Talanoa independently, talking to users, breaking things, rebuilding them, and questioning quite a few assumptions we’ve had about email for the last 30 years. What started as a tool I built for myself has slowly become something much bigger, and this version finally feels like the Talanoa I always wanted to use. I’d genuinely love your feedback, especially on one thing: Does the “email as a conversation” approach change the way you feel about your inbox? And if there’s one thing your current email client does that you couldn’t live without, tell me. I’m listening 👇 Thanks for checking out Talanoa ❤️ John

John, this is a great app! But one thing: is it possible to have a web version? With yet another app open on my Mac, things just get messy. I like how Gmail just sits in a Chrome tab, all in one place and organized.

Hey John, I use a team inbox with a few other team members - maybe this is outside the scope, but are there any plans for supporting that kind of group inbox situation? I could see Talanoa bridging that gap nicely, given how it completely rewrites the UX of an inbox anyway. Great looking product, btw.

Congrats on the launch, John. Stripping quotes and signatures is what makes the chat view work, but it is also where email gets tricky. When someone answers inline, typing their replies between lines of the quoted message, does Talanoa detect and keep those interleaved answers, or can they get hidden as quoted text? That case comes up a lot in long threads with lawyers and engineers.
I like the privacy angle of it: on-device, no cloud sync. The clean chat view is a nice bonus too. Does the on-device AI work offline?

week.name: UseIt Studio

week.name: Navige
week.tagline: Cut AI agent costs and control runaway spending
week.description: Navige uses Sufficiency Intelligence to cut AI agent costs while work runs. It sends suitable requests to smaller models, caches repeated reads and trims bulky tool results. If unsure, it keeps your chosen model. Set budgets, catch runaway loops and approve sensitive actions. See costs and savings by job, with estimates clearly labelled. Watchtower is free forever. Preview changes before switching controls on.
week.categoryFa: نرم‌افزار ابری • ابزار توسعه‌دهندگان • هوش مصنوعی

comments.text: Hey Product Hunt 👋Why we built NavigeMost of what an AI agent does isn’t hard - sorting an email, pulling a date out of a document, picking the next step. But often, it all runs on the most expensive model, because that’s the one written into the code and nobody went back to change it.Then the bill arrives as one number, and nobody can say which agent spent what.Navige sits in front of calls routed through it and acts before they run, while the cost can still change. We call this Sufficiency Intelligence: give each task exactly the intelligence it needs.How it worksIt assesses each request and sends suitable ones to a smaller model. Your model is the ceiling: Navige only moves calls down, never up, and keeps yours whenever it’s unsure.If the smaller model fumbles a tool call, the call re-runs on your original model, and your agent only sees that answer.It records every job: what it cost, what the controls changed and what made the difference. Measured savings and estimates are clearly separated.On top of that, you get budgets per team and per job, approval holds for risky actions, a kill switch and an audit trail.Two things we did on purposeWatchtower is the starting point. Navige watches and shows what it would have done, but changes nothing until you say so.Connect your Anthropic or AWS Bedrock account and put your real bill next to Navige’s figures, so you can check the numbers instead of trusting a savings claim.PricingWatchtower is free forever. On paid plans, of the measured savings Navige can show, you keep four parts and we keep one, subject to a $9/month minimum.Give it a weekWatch your agents for a week. Nothing changes until you decide.Which of your agents’ jobs do you suspect is running on a much bigger model than it needs? 👇
runaway agent bills are a real pain rn, smart angle 💸 does it work with any model provider?
Can I leave Watchtower running for a month and then decide whether to upgrade?
Why would I use Navige instead of just switching all my agents to cheaper models myself?
Do we need to give API access? Or does this work with the UI versions of the LLMs too?
I went through your website and really liked the pricing model. It’s a masterclass.How did you arrive at this model? Through conversations with customers?

Congrats Soji, Akhil, and the Navige team on the launch. The rule that a fumbled tool call re-runs on the original model is a sensible safety net. Since the paid plan is a share of measured savings, does the cost of that failed small-model attempt get netted out of the savings figure for the job, and does Watchtower show how often each agent hits that fallback?
Why should I put another service between my AI agents and their providers? Isn't that another thing that could break?

faComments.text: سلام Product Hunt 👋 چرا ناویج را ساختیم؟ بیشتر کارهایی که یک عامل هوش مصنوعی انجام می‌دهد دشوار نیستند - مرتب‌سازی ایمیل، استخراج تاریخ از یک سند، انتخاب گام بعدی. اما اغلب، همه این‌ها روی گران‌ترین مدل اجرا می‌شوند، زیرا همان مدلی است که در کد نوشته شده و کسی برنگشته تا آن را تغییر دهد. سپس فاکتور به صورت یک عدد واحد می‌رسد و کسی نمی‌تواند بگوید کدام عامل چقدر هزینه کرده است. ناویج در برابر فراخوانی‌هایی که از طریق آن مسیریابی می‌شوند قرار می‌گیرد و پیش از اجرا عمل می‌کند، در حالی که هنوز امکان تغییر هزینه وجود دارد. ما به این می‌گوییم هوش کفایت: به هر وظیفه دقیقاً همان هوشی را بده که نیاز دارد. چگونه کار می‌کند؟ هر درخواست را ارزیابی می‌کند و موارد مناسب را به مدل کوچک‌تری ارسال می‌کند. مدل شما سقف است: ناویج فقط فراخوانی‌ها را به پایین می‌برد، هرگز به بالا، و هر زمان که مطمئن نباشد، از مدل شما استفاده می‌کند. اگر مدل کوچک‌تر در فراخوانی ابزار شکست بخورد، فراخوانی روی مدل اصلی شما دوباره اجرا می‌شود و عامل شما فقط آن پاسخ را می‌بیند. هر شغل را ثبت می‌کند: چقدر هزینه کرد، کنترل‌ها چه چیزی را تغییر دادند و چه چیزی تفاوت ایجاد کرد. صرفه‌جویی‌های اندازه‌گیری شده و تخمین‌ها به وضوح جدا شده‌اند. علاوه بر این، بودجه‌بندی به تفکیک تیم و شغل، توقف برای تأیید اقدامات پرخطر، کلید خاموش‌سازی و ردیابی ممیزی دریافت می‌کنید. دو چیزی که عمداً انجام دادیم: ماچ‌تاور نقطه شروع است. ناویج تماشا می‌کند و نشان می‌دهد چه کاری انجام می‌داد، اما تا زمانی که شما نگوئید چیزی را تغییر نمی‌دهد. حساب Anthropic یا AWS Bedrock خود را متصل کنید و فاکتور واقعی خود را کنار اعداد ناویج بگذارید، بنابراین می‌توانید اعداد را بررسی کنید به جای اعتماد به ادعای صرفه‌جویی. قیمت‌گذاری: ماچ‌تاور برای همیشه رایگان است. در طرح‌های پولی، از صرفه‌جویی‌های اندازه‌گیری شده‌ای که ناویج می‌تواند نشان دهد، شما چهار قسمت را نگه می‌دارید و ما یک قسمت را نگه می‌داریم، مشروط به حداقل ۹ دلار در ماه. یک هفته امتحان کنید: عامل‌های خود را یک هفته تماشا کنید. تا زمانی که تصمیم نگیرید، چیزی تغییر نمی‌کند. شک دارید کدام شغل عامل‌های شما روی مدلی بسیار بزرگ‌تر از نیاز اجرا می‌شود؟ 👇

week.aiReview: مسئله اصلی که این محصول حل می‌کند، هزینه‌های غیرقابل پیش‌بینی و پنهان در استفاده از عامل‌های هوش مصنوعی است. راه‌حل ناویج، اعمال یک لایه هوشمند بین کد کاربر و APIهای مدل‌هاست که با تحلیل پیچیدگی هر درخواست، آن را به مناسب‌ترین مدل (ترجیحاً کوچک‌تر) هدایت می‌کند. از نظر معماری، این سیستم به صورت یک پروکسی هوشمند عمل می‌کند که قابلیت فیلتر کردن، کش کردن و مسیریابی مجدد درخواست‌ها را دارد. مدل درآمدی مبتنی بر «سهم از صرفه‌جویی» بسیار هوشمندانه است زیرا ریسک را به دوش خود می‌گیرد و ارزش را مستقیماً به سود مشتری گره می‌زند. نقاط قوت شامل شفافیت کامل در گزارش‌دهی، وجود حالت مشاهده (Watchtower) برای کاهش ریسک ورودی، و مکانیزم ایمنی برای بازگشت به مدل اصلی در صورت شکست است. نقاط ضعف می‌تواند شامل پیچیدگی فنی در استقرار و نگرانی‌های امنیتی در مورد عبور داده‌ها از یک سرویس میانی باشد. نکته طلایی برای ایران: با توجه به محدودیت‌های ارزی و دسترسی به APIهای خارجی، توسعه نسخه‌ای از این محصول که با مدل‌های زبانی داخلی (مانند مدل‌های مبتنی بر Llama یا Qwen که به صورت محلی یا از طریق سرویس‌های داخلی اجرا می‌شوند) کار کند، می‌تواند مزیت رقابتی بزرگی ایجاد کند. همچنین، ارائه گزارش‌دهی به زبان فارسی و پشتیبانی از روش‌های پرداخت داخلی، کلید موفقیت در بازار ایران خواهد بود.

month.description: Make videos with Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI agent. Give Clueso an idea, deck, reference video, or recording, and it handles the whole video production: storyboard, scenes, voiceover, music, and editing, on-brand. Everything stays editable, by hand or by chat.

comments.text: Hey Product Hunt Community! 👋I’m Neel, co-founder of Clueso.We launched Clueso here last year with a pretty simple idea: turn rough screen recordings into polished product videos in minutes.The response was incredible. Thousands of people started using Clueso, and this community made us #1 Product of the Day, Week, and Month.Over the last year, we kept seeing people push Clueso beyond what we originally built it for. They wanted to start with more than a screen recording. They wanted to make more kinds of videos. And increasingly, they wanted AI to do more of the actual work.So today we’re launching Clueso MCP.Now you can create and edit videos directly from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible agent.Give it a prompt and whatever material you have: a screen recording, deck, document, URL, Figma file, raw footage, reference video you like, or just an idea.Clueso takes it from there. It plans the video, creates the scenes, writes the script, generates the AI voiceover, adds music, motion graphics, captions and animations, edits everything together, and applies your branding.In fact, our product hunt launch video above was made entirely with Clueso MCP.Basically, you tell it what you want to make, and it makes the video with you.The part we care a lot about is control.A lot of AI video tools feel like black boxes: you prompt them, get a finished clip back, and if something isn’t quite right, your main option is to keep regenerating.Clueso is different because there’s a powerful video editor underneath the agent. Everything it creates remains editable. You can open the project and change anything yourself, or just keep chatting with the agent.You could be a marketer making a launch video, a founder making a product demo, a freelancer creating something for a client, a small business making marketing content, or just someone with an idea they want to turn into a great video.Here’s what you can do with it:Create from inspiration. Give Clueso a few videos you like or a moodboard. It understands the look, feel, and creative direction you’re going for, then creates a full video around your own content, product, and brand.Create pretty much any kind of video. Launch and marketing videos, product demos, walkthroughs, tutorials, explainers, social content, complex motion graphics, animated sequences, logo animations and more.Edit however you want. Jump into the Clueso editor and make changes yourself, or just chat with the agent and ask it to make the edits for you.Build custom workflows around video. No learning curve. No plugins.Built-in sandboxing, designed from day one for safety and trust.Just open it, talk to it, and let your agent work with you.We’re the original team behind Trickle, and this is our clean break into what we believe is the real shape of 2026:agent-native computing, with a human-first GUI.Would love your feedback, questions, and ideas 👇Thanks for checking out Happycapy 🦫✨Fun Easter egg 🥳: our design team hid a little tribute to the very first GUI computers on the landing page — see if you can spot it. 👀

When you're giving an agent full shell access to your actual system, the attack vectors get pretty real pretty fast. Prompt injection, unintended file modifications, credential exposure, etc.Love that you guys are leaning into built-in sandboxing and running directly in the browser as the approach here. If the sandboxing story is solid, this could be a huge differentiator over the self-hosted alternatives. My current multi-agent OS includes a mixture of protocols, not just openclaw, so always looking for new tools and methods.

Full disclosure — I'm a big fan of Anthropic and actually built an app that works exclusively with Claude Desktop for secure local file search. So I've spent a lot of time thinking about this space.My concern with Cowork isn't the vision, it's the architecture. Agentic tasks burn through tokens fast (Anthropic says so themselves), so that $200/month cap can disappear quicker than you'd expect. And at that price, you'd want to use it for real work — but the whole thing requires giving Claude direct read/write/delete access to your files. If you're handling client data, patient records, or anything regulated, you're basically out.The bigger issue is prompt injection. Anthropic admits "the chances of an attack are still non-zero" — and back in October 2025, researchers showed exactly that: a prompt injection against Claude that pulled up to 30MB of user data per request through Anthropic's own API. When you're talking about an agent with file system access, email connectors, and a browser, that's not some theoretical edge case.There's a reason some of us build tools where Claude can search your files without actually touching them. The agentic future is definitely coming, but "AI that can access everything" and "AI that keeps you in control" are two very different products for two very different users.
